item.title: Event Optimization: Debounce vs Throttle
item.description: Ever hooked an event listener to a search input or a window scroll, and watched your browser tab turn into an airplane jet engine? :v Events like input, scroll, and mousemove fire dozens of times per second. If every single keystroke triggers an expensive API request or complex DOM recalculation, your interface will lag and your server will hate you. The remedy? Debounce and Throttle. Let’s break down the difference with practical code you can drop into any project.
